live.instructions:
Prayer times (Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) for any city, from quranmajeed.com/prayer-times, by the makers of Quran Majeed.
Times come from official published timetables where one exists (London Central Mosque, Jordan's Ministry of Awqaf, UAE, Oman, Malaysia, Indonesia, Morocco, ...) or are calculated for the city's coordinates with the method the Prayer Times app applies for that country. Daylight saving is included; times are in the city's local time.
Use get_prayer_times with a city name (or a place_id from search_city when a name is ambiguous, e.g. "London" in Canada). Use search_city when you are unsure which place the user means.
When you answer, mention the date the times are for and cite the page URL returned in "source".

tools.name: get_prayer_times
tools.title: Prayer times for a city
tools.description: Prayer times (Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) for a city on a date. Give either `city` (name or site slug such as "london", "new-york", "london-ca" for London, Ontario) or `place_id` (GeoNames id from search_city). `date` is YYYY-MM-DD in the city's local calendar (default: today there). Set `month` true for every day of that month. Returns local times, the UTC offset, the Hijri date, the calculation method or official timetable, and the page URL to cite.

city.description: City name or slug, e.g. "Karachi", "kuala lumpur", "london-ca"

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; default today in that city

month.description: true: every day of the month of `date`

tools.name: search_city
tools.title: Find a city
tools.description: Search cities and towns by name (any spelling, e.g. "Makkah" or "Mecca"). Returns candidates with their country, region, coordinates, time zone and GeoNames id; pass the id as place_id to get_prayer_times. Optional two-letter country code to narrow the search.

query.description: City name, at least two characters

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. PK
